info.title: TwoPlacePaste admin API
info.description:
The admin API does over HTTP what the relay's [admin page](https://mark7888.github.io/two-place-paste/self-hosting/admin/)
does in a browser: mint creation tokens, watch storage, manage groups, tags and
settings, and read the audit log. Like the admin page it never shows content —
the relay has none to show.

The guide, with examples, is [The admin API](https://mark7888.github.io/two-place-paste/self-hosting/api/).

## Authentication

Every request but the two that return this description carries an API key:

```http
Authorization: Bearer tpp_ak_xxxxxxxx_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Keys are created on the admin page's **API keys** screen, or on the relay's host
with `tpp apikey create`. The API cannot create, list or revoke keys. A key is
shown once, when it is created; the relay keeps only a hash of it.

A key has one or more scopes:

| Scope | Allows |
|---|---|
| `read` | Every `GET`, except creation-token links and QR codes |
| `tokens` | Listing, creating and revoking creation tokens, and their links and QR codes |
| `admin` | Everything, including purging and deleting groups. Implies `read` and `tokens`. |

## Rate limits

Each key has its own budget, refilled continuously: by default 10 reads a second
with bursts of 60, and 2 changes a second with bursts of 10. Every authenticated
response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`
(seconds until the budget is full again). A request over the budget gets `429`
with `Retry-After`. Failed authentication is limited per client address as well.

## Errors

Errors are `application/problem+json` ([RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457))
with a stable `code` to branch on: `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `not_found`,
`invalid_request`, `conflict`, `rate_limited`, `unavailable` or `internal`. The
`detail` sentence is for people and may change.

## Names

A group's id is the creation token that made it, which is a credential, so the
API never shows one. Groups and tokens are named by a **handle** instead: an
opaque string the relay derives from the id. A token and the group it created
have the same handle. Tags are named by their name.

## Changes and versions

Within `/api/v1`, changes only add: new endpoints, new optional request fields,
new response fields and new error codes. Ignore fields you do not know. Anything
that would break a caller waits for `/api/v2`.

Destructive calls — purging and deleting — happen at once. There is no
confirmation step and no undo.

servers.description: Your relay's public base URL, followed by /api/v1

tags.name: Relay
tags.description: The dashboard's numbers, the relay's health and the blob sweep.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Groups, their devices, storage and store. Groups are named by their handle.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags group groups together and can carry storage limits for them.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description:
Creation tokens. A token's URL creates one group; hand it to the person who
will set it up. Token lists never contain a URL.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Settings the relay keeps at runtime.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: The last 1000 admin actions, whoever made them.

tags.name: Description
tags.description: This document, for tools that read OpenAPI.

get.description: Counts and storage, as on the admin page's dashboard.

The running build and whether Redis is set up the way the relay needs it
(eviction policy and AOF).

post.description: Queues a sweep of expired blobs. It runs in the background.

202.description: The sweep was queued, or one was already waiting.

get.description: One page of the groups, searched, filtered and sorted.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The column to sort by. Defaults to `storage`.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only the groups under this tag, or `-` for the untagged ones.

get.description: A group with its devices and its storage and store limits.

patch.description:
Changes only the fields given. Every field is checked before any is applied,
so a request with one bad field changes nothing. A rename reaches the
group's online devices at once.

delete.description:
Deletes the group, its devices and its entries, and empties its store.
Its devices are disconnected at once and told the group was deleted.
**There is no confirmation and no undo.**

post.description:
Deletes every clipboard entry of the group now, instead of when it
expires. The store is not touched. **There is no undo.**

Deletes every item of the group's store, for every device. The store
closes at once and is emptied in the background; the switch and the
limits stay as they are. **There is no undo.**

202.description: The purge was queued. The counts are what the store held.

get.description: One page of the tags, with the groups, devices and storage under each.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The column to sort by. Defaults to `name`.

patch.description:
Changes the storage and store limits the tag gives its groups. A group's
own limit, when on, still wins over its tag's.

delete.description: Its groups are left untagged and fall back to their own limits or the defaults.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The column to sort by. Defaults to `created`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only tokens in this state. `used` includes tokens whose group was deleted.

post.description:
Mints a token and returns its creation URL. Hand the URL to the person who
will create the group; opening it in the app creates the group.

201.description: The new token and its creation URL.

delete.description:
Deletes an unused token, so its URL creates nothing. A token that already
created a group cannot be revoked: delete the group instead.

get.description: Only an unused, unexpired token has one.
The creation URL as a QR code, for a phone to scan. Only an unused, unexpired token has one.
One page of the audit log, newest first by default.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The column to sort by. Defaults to `when`.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only entries of this action, e.g. `group.delete`.

200.description: One page of the audit log.

apiKey.description: An API key from the admin page's **API keys** screen or `tpp apikey create`.

Handle.name: handle
Handle.description: The handle of a group or token.

Q.name: q
Q.description: Search words. A row matches when every word appears in one of its columns, ignoring case.

Dir.name: dir
Dir.description: The sort direction. Each column has its own default.

Page.name: page
Page.description: The page, from 1. A page past the end gives the last page.

BadRequest.description: The request is not valid. `detail` says what to fix.

Unauthorized.description: The request has no valid API key, or the key has expired or was revoked.

Forbidden.description: The API key does not have the scope this call needs.

NotFound.description: There is no such group, tag or token.

Conflict.description: The change conflicts with what exists, e.g. a tag of that name or a token that was already used.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

Unavailable.description: This relay does not have the feature, e.g. it runs without a store.

code.description: What went wrong, stable across versions. New codes may be added.

detail.description: What went wrong, for people. It may change.
examples: That group does not exist. It may have been deleted.

Limit.description:
A storage limit override. While `enabled` is false the override does not
count but `bytes` is kept. `bytes` 0 means no limit of its own.

LimitChange.description:
A change to a limit override. Leave out `bytes` to keep the stored size,
e.g. to turn an override off. A size may not exceed the relay's total limit.

LimitSettings.description: A group's own override and what it falls back to.

tag_bytes.description: The limit of the group's tag, when the tag's override is on.

default_bytes.description: The relay's configured default. 0 is no limit.

unused_tokens.description: Tokens that can still create a group.

stale_after_days.description: How long a group may go without a device connecting before it is stale.

storage.description: Blob storage, or null when the relay does not account it.

store.description: The store, or null when the relay has none.

Problems.description: Parts that could not be read. The rest of the response is still valid.

group_limit_bytes.description: The default per-group limit. 0 is none.

evictions.description: Entries evicted in the last day to stay under a limit.

groups_on.description: Groups with their store turned on.

queued.description: False when a sweep was already waiting to run.

short_id.description: Enough of the group's id to tell groups apart. It is not a credential.

tag.description: The group's tag, or empty when it has none.

last_seen.description: When a device of the group last connected.

stale.description: No device has connected for longer than the stale threshold.

store.description: The group's store, or null when the relay has none.

limit_bytes.description: The cap the group runs into, its own or the relay's total. 0 is none.

over_limit.description: The group holds more than its limit, after the limit was lowered. Its next upload evicts down to it.

emptying.description: A purge or deletion is emptying the store; it is closed until then.

LimitSource.description: Where a group's limit comes from.

store_limit.description: The store limit settings, or null when the relay has no store.

protocol_level.description: The protocol level the device's app speaks: its open connection's while it is online, otherwise the one it last connected with. Null when the device has not connected since the relay began recording levels. Compare it with the group detail's `protocol` range.

ProtocolRange.description: The protocol levels this relay accepts. A device below `min` cannot connect until its app is updated; one below `max` works without what the newer levels added.

GroupChange.description: The fields to change. Leave out the ones to keep.

tag.description: The tag to put the group under, or empty for none. The tag must exist.

store.description: Turns the group's store on or off. Turning it off keeps the items.

used_bytes.description: Blob storage the tag's groups use together.

name.description: A letter or digit, then up to 39 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.

tag.description: The tag the group starts under, or empty.

group_handle.description: The handle of the group the token created, while that group exists.

tag.description: The tag the new group starts under. It must exist.

expires_in_days.description: When the token stops working if unused. Leave out for never.

url.description: The creation URL. It is a credential until the group is created.

kind.description: `admin` is a signed-in admin page, `api_key` a call to this API, `cli` the `tpp` command.

key_name.description: The API key's name when the change was made.

total.description: Rows that match, across all pages.
